description: BlenderGIS EPSG:3857 scene origin derived from the campus scene used by ground.ply
grid_interval_interpretation: Nominal map spacing is expressed in the internal EPSG:3857-derived Blender local coordinate system; it is not an exact geodetic ground-distance interval.
web_mercator_scale_note: At latitude phi, EPSG:3857 local scale factor is approximately sec(phi); one projected metre corresponds approximately cos(phi) ground metres away from the equator.

axis_definition.blender_x: EPSG:3857 easting minus scene origin X, then scale/offset
axis_definition.blender_y: EPSG:3857 northing minus scene origin Y, then scale/offset
axis_definition.blender_z: terrain elevation from ground.ply; receiver_z = ground_z + 1.5 m
